rationale: Several papers provide substantive new evidence on the Hubble tension. Paper 2606.05358 discusses the impact of evolving dark energy models on local $H_0$ measurements. Paper 2601.00650 analyzes a diverse set of Sound Horizon-free $H_0$ measurements, challenging the traditional framing of the tension. Paper 2602.12822 examines the inverse distance ladder method, and paper 2509.16202 presents a sound-horizon-agnostic determination of $H_0$. These contributions advance understanding but do not fully resolve the tension.
